51.
All members of the Commission, officers and staff
of the Audit Office shall be deemed to be public servants
within the meaning and for the purposes of the Penal Code.

52.
The Audit Office shall be deemed to be a Scheduled
Institution within the meaning of the Bribery Act, and the
provisions of that Act, shall be construed accordingly.

53.
Auditor General’s Fees Act, No. 26 of 1958 is hereby

54.
(1) The Auditor General’s Department shall cease
to be in operation from the date of operation of this Act.
